why: An 8B continuous flow language model trained cheaply from AR models, matching AR quality, adds to the non-autoregressive generation direction alongside diffusion LMs.

gist: HexaShell is a coding agent that controls a dual-arm robot via vision and self-written tools, achieving state-of-the-art results on RoboDojo but struggling with contact-heavy tasks.
title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
why: Shows how far a thin-harness VLM coding agent can drive a real robot, with strong community attention.

gist: A decoder-free, action-conditioned world model predicts next-screen representations to verify GUI transitions and detect hijacked screens with high accuracy and low latency.
title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
why: A world model used to verify GUI agent transitions is a fresh safety angle for computer-use agents, but still a niche technique.

gist: Glimpse is a multimodal visual reasoning model from Elorian, built for visual understanding and complex visual reasoning in the physical world.
title: Elorian: Glimpse
why: Elorian's Glimpse is a new multimodal visual reasoning model for physical-world use cases from a lab not seen before.
